item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 26/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today, and it is expected to moderate gradually in the next few days. Temperatures will rise gradually over the region, but it will still be cool in the morning. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will bring a few rain patches to the coast of southern China. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect southern China next week, it will be bright over the region.
